usage: agentware kb-git commit [-h] [--path PATH] [--tag TAG]
                               [--type {feat,chore}] [--message MESSAGE]

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --path PATH          KB repo dir to commit (default: the resolved knowledge
                       dir)
  --tag TAG            commit scope tag (sanitized to [a-z0-9._-]; default:
                       kb)
  --type {feat,chore}  conventional-commit type (default: chore)
  --message MESSAGE    commit summary (default: deterministic changed-dirs
                       summary)
